client facing banker
responsible for a seamless execution on onboarding and implementation, service coordination and credit management. This position acts as a central point of contact for clients and internal partners, ensuring operational efficiency and effective relationship support.

Relationship & Origination Support
Maintain professional and strategic relationships with key client representatives and decision-makers.
Understand client drivers and support Subsidiary Account Managers, Regional Account Managers (RAMs) and Parent Account Managers (PAMs), as applicable, in origination activities.
Mentor junior Client Managers in understanding client needs and identifying business opportunities.
Execute key strategic business campaigns, including comprehensive account planning, wallet sizing, and corridor or product initiatives.

Credit Management
Oversee and manage credit requests in close coordination with various internal teams, providing input and ensuring timely resolution.
Timely oversight and guidance on credit risk mitigation, monitoring credit lines, and escalating exceptions.
Onboarding & Implementation
Manage the end-to-end client onboarding experience for clients, from initiating CRM requests to post-implementation follow up.
Identify best practices for client documentation and facilitate comprehensive client training programs to ensure a seamless and efficient transition for clients.
Service Coordination
Act as a primary escalation point and trusted advisor for strategic clients, expertly managing and resolving client issues.
Facilitate operational efficiency and client satisfaction by optimizing day-to-day operational flows, analyzing client feedback, and identifying proactive solutions.
KYC Ownership
Oversee and ensure the integrity of KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for a portfolio of clients.
Take responsibility for completing, maintaining, and reviewing accurate client profiles, and mentor junior team members on KYC best practices and regulatory requirements.

6-10 years of Experience
Technical Skills: Advanced product knowledge and a comprehensive understanding of operational processes and in depth knowledge of KYC/AML regulatory requirements.

The department is responsible for:
Controlled posting of certain cash transactions to the investment and accounting book of records Management and control of exceptions arising from the reconciliations of cash, stock and units Review and correction of any overdrawn account balances Liaison with external & internal parties to resolve exceptions Implementing enhancements, including automation of the processes Internal reporting of key management information on the above, alongside some reporting to certain external clients

The jobholder will be responsible for supervising the reconciliations of a group of accounts and a variety of additional tasks, which will include using Excel spreadsheets, receiving and acting upon various email instructions and liaising by telephone or in person with other departments. There are a variety of control tasks to be performed on a daily/weekly or monthly basis.
Perform daily reconciliations using specialist software and assist in the supervision of other team members
Oversee and participate in the identification, analysis and resolution of exceptions in a timely manner
Oversee and participate in liaison with global stakeholders both verbally and by other means to resolve exceptions
Post entries to the accounting system which have not been automatically generated, including team oversight
Collaborate with the UK / India based team to manage workflows and complete tasks

Organisational capabilities – able to remain focused on own targets while supporting others in achieving theirs

Experience in financial services or regulated industries with demonstrable knowledge of regulatory controls, audit preparation and model risk governance.

Proven ability to lead cross‑functional engineering teams through technological transformations, and to operationalise AI safely at scale.

Architecture and platform designs that meet non‑functional requirements (scalability, resiliency, security).
Successful delivery of prioritized Tech Risk Control book‑of‑work items and remediation actions.
Reduction in incident mean‑time‑to‑detect and mean‑time‑to‑recover through improved observability, RCA and runbooks.
Mature AI/ML deployment pipelines with documented governance, monitoring and model lifecycle controls.
High team engagement, evidence of knowledge transfer via deep dive sessions and measurable uplift in engineering capability.

Familiar on one or more tech skill.
Strong Java expertise (Java 8/11/17/21/25), demonstrated through large‑scale, production systems.
Deep experience with Spring ecosystem: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data and related tooling.
Microservices and cloud‑native architectures: containerisation (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and 12‑factor app principles.
Event streaming and messaging: Apache Kafka (Kafka Streams, ksqlDB), Confluent tooling and best practices for exactly‑once semantics and fault‑tolerant processing.
Data platform familiarity: batch/stream processing (Spark, Flink), data lakehouse concepts (Delta Lake), and data governance tools (e.g. Apache Atlas, Apache Falcon or equivalent).
AI / ML / LLM productionisation: hands‑on with MLOps and Model frameworks (LangGraph, Agent Development Kit, Microsoft Agent Framework ); experience deploying and operating LLMs (e.g., Falcon family or other LLMs), embeddings, RAG architectures and frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
Observability, reliability and performance engineering: Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK, distributed tracing (Jaeger/Zipkin), profiling and tuning high‑throughput systems.
DevOps, CI/CD :Terraform, Ansible , G3 , and SonarQube.
Cloud platforms: proven experience on at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) in production scale environments.
Security, compliance & risk controls: secure coding practices, threat modelling, encryption, key management and OWASP mitigation patterns.

Job Description

Job Summary

Develop and implement communications strategy and programs to continuously protect and promote the Bank's brand and bring to life the Bank's business strategy and core values via multiple external/internal touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Play a pivot role in developing and implementing communications strategy consistent with the Bank’s business strategies and priorities in China
  • Continuously build profile and uplift visibility for the bank in areas relating to Corporate & Investment Banking, Branding initiatives and Corporate Social Responsibilities

Business

  • Sound knowledge of the Bank’s global franchise, China market and a good understanding of the opportunities opening up for CIB business
  • Develop and implement strategic communications plan and roadmap, focusing on the Bank's strategy and business priorities
  • Focus on the following areas of CIB business from strategy to communications programmes & execution:
  • Coverage – Corporates & Financial Institutions
  • CIB Products – TB & FM
  • Initiatives such as China Opening-up, Chinese Enterprises Going Global, RMB Internationalisation, Belt & Road, Financial Connectivity Schemes, Sustainable and Transition Finance, Digitalisation
  • Executive profiling for senior executives' thought leadership in line with respective business focuses
  • Develop press releases, executive speeches, Op-Ed, WeChat articles and LinkedIn posts for corporate and business communications related programs
  • Arrange media interviews on proactive basis for major business developments/milestones and the Bank's focus areas
  • Lead media relations for China East region and provide communications support for reputational risk management for incidents in East

Risk Management

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundering, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct
  • Work closely with media monitoring agency to be aware of related media voice on potential issues and provide sound judgement and mitigation plan from communications perspective
  • Play a key role in reputational risk management for the Bank, and work as a key CABM contact window for China East Region

Governance

  • Ensure adherence to the Risk Management Framework, Group Code of Conduct and various Policies, Procedures and Guidelines of the Bank by the Group and China CABM teams
  • Play a pivotal role in guiding relevant stakeholders on communications-related guidelines and best practices
  • Maintain high awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the business operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role
  • Completion of all mandatory training needed including e-learning within stated timeframes to support the understanding of the roles for delivering effective governance

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

Internal

  • China EXCO members
  • CIB China Head Office & CIB Business
  • East CGMs
  • China & Group CABM

External

  • Media
  • Communications counterparts at regulatory/ governmental authorities
  • Key financial analysts & opinion leaders
  • General public

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CABM
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

Skills and Experience

  • Communications Strategy & Planning
  • Copywriting & Content Development
  • Media Engagement & Management
  • Reputational Risk Management
  • Strategic & Creative Thinking

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of communications experience, preferably with experience related to the financial services industry
  • Proven communications expertise, with the ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies across earned, owned, and paid media channels
  • Strong writing, editing, and content development skills in both Chinese and English
  • Sound judgment and experience in issues and reputational risk management
